podcast.body: Ariana Grande's 2024 chart-topper "Yes, And?" served as a "clapback at her haters in the media," drawing comparisons to the style of Bob Dylan or Billy Joel. This demonstrates the continued presence of diss tracks in the mainstream pop diet, utilized by major pop stars to address public scrutiny. "Ariana Grande, who's 2024, Shark Topper, Yes and, clapped back at her haters in the media, Allah Bob Dylan or Billy Joel."
